tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All General Conditions of Eligibility as per the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer shall also produce satisfactory work completion certificate(s) issued by the concerned government and public sector undertaking along with a certified copy of the previous supply orders issued to them by the concerned state. Central government departments and public sector units

The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the items similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements (Section V) up to at least 80 % of the type of items mentioned in the Schedule of requirement and 40% of the type of items mentioned in the Schedule of requirement with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25. (in any one of the last 2 years for Micro and Small Enterprises). The items offered for supply must be of most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design.

b)Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative or authorized regular dealer of a manufacturer can also be considered provided (i)the manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC

ii)The tenderer, as authorized representative and should have a registered office in Karnataka and should have supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least 30% of the similar items as specified in the schedule of requirements in any one of the last 3 years 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 in which 30% of quantity must have been supplied by the dealer.

iii)The Tenderer shall have successfully executed similar projects, as specified in Section V of this Tender Document, for any State Government, Central Government Department, or Public Sector Undertaking during any one of the last three financial years, i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24, or 2024-25. The value of the Supply Order executed under one single order during any one of the aforesaid financial years shall not be less than INR 2.50 Crores

All tenderers that are quoting as authorized representatives of manufacturers shall be required to produce a true copy of the authorizing manufactures license/registration issued by the Competitive Authority. Government of Karnataka or equivalent license/registration issued by any other Government Authority in India to such manufacturer along with the authorization specified in (b) of Section VII
The tenderer shall be a manufacturer or authorized dealer who have ISO certificate are eligible to participated in the tender

The Bidder/OEM should upload original manufacturing license (MSME) & Factories registration certificate issued to them by the concerned State or Central Government certifying them as manufacturer of Hand Tools and Equipment

The tenderer must have an office and a sales and service center located in Karnataka and shall have operated out of such office and such sales and service center for at least previous 3 (three) years i.e.2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 necessary proof to be produced.
Bids from any Manufacturer or Dealer from any of the banned /Restricted/ prohibited countries by Government of India will not be entertained and the Bidder must submit a notarized declaration

The Hand Tools and Equipments to be supplied shall be of reputed manufacturers, and Manufacturers Authorization Forms (MAFs) must be submitted for all Hand Tools and equipments/ mentioned in Schedule V. All such Hand Tools and Equipments shall conform to prevailing industry standards. A detailed brochure and a list specifying the make brand of the items proposed for supply shall be included in the Schedule of Requirements and submitted as part of the bid documents. Furthermore, at least 70% of the items for which MAFs are submitted, complete technical specifications must be available and verifiable on the respective Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) official website
Where ever applicable Self attested copy of ISO / BIS Certification copy of the Manufacturer/ Bidder

The Tenderer shall submit copies of GST registration Certificate recent GST clearance and GST returns filed in the last 3 years 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 issued by the Commercial Taxes Department and Latest GST R3B return filed certificate

The Tenderer must submit turnover certificate for the previous three financial years from a certified Chartered Accountant along with P & L accounts,balance sheet for the last three years.The minimum Average Annual financial turnover for the last three financial years inclusive of all taxes for Authorized Dealers Rs.3 Crores during the last three financial years 2022-23,2023-24 and 2024-25 and for Micro and Small Enterprises Rs.1.5 Crores during the last two financial years 2023-24 & 2024-25
Positive Net worth Statement certified by CA in each of the last 3 FY (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) and Profit Declaration Statement by Tenderer
The Tenderer shall produce copy of its Income Tax returns for the last three financial years i.e., FYs 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
The tenderer must submit a hard copy of the section V, mentioning the MAKE of the Hand Tools and Equipment to 145 Udyoga GITIs in Technical Bid
